comment: Which issue owns a gap with libwebrtc (tools/parity_report.py). Rules match the scenario and metric with fnmatch patterns; every matching rule adds its issues. Keep it in step with the work list in roadmap issue #64 and the deviation inventory (docs/design/libwebrtc-parity.md). A gap with no owner needs an issue or an approved deviation.
